title: Phase I: Multi-BKM Composition Operational Experiment (4-Arm Randomized Trial)
user_cohort: COHORT-CANARY-E5 (N=40 independent operators randomized 1:1:1:1 across 4 arms)
goal: Empirically measure the real-world operational interaction between BKM-CANARY-001 (Deterministic Edge Sanitization) and OBS-CANARY-002 (Real-Time Accessible Dynamic Guidance) across 4 controlled arms on a complex Batch Parameter Migration Console.
